Bob Smith
bob@example.com | GitHub: github.com/bobsmith

Python Backend Engineer

SUMMARY
Python Backend Engineer with 3+ years of experience designing and delivering high-performance backend systems. Proficient in FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and Docker, with hands-on expertise building and maintaining REST APIs in cloud environments. Skilled in writing unit tests and collaborating through code reviews to ensure code quality and reliability.

EXPERIENCE
Backend Developer, StartupXYZ (2021-2024)
- Developed and maintained Python backend services using FastAPI, building scalable REST APIs consumed by web and mobile clients.
- Architected PostgreSQL schemas and integrated Redis with Celery for distributed task queuing, improving async job throughput by 40%.
- Used Docker and AWS for deployment, streamlining CI/CD pipelines and reducing release cycle time.

SKILLS
Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, Docker, AWS, REST APIs
